gloss: another world; paradise; a place apart

definitions.gloss: another world; a place apart; paradise
definitions.explanation: A place so different from ordinary surroundings that it feels like a separate world. Almost always positive: quiet, beautiful, or refreshingly free of everyday pressures.

examples.japanese: ここはまるで{別天地|べってんち}だ。
examples.english: This place is like another world.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{上|うえ}は{静|しず}かで、{別天地|べってんち}のようだった。
examples.english: The mountaintop was quiet, like a world apart.

examples.japanese: {都会|とかい}の{騒音|そうおん}を{離|はな}れると、この{島|しま}はまさに{別天地|べってんち}である。
examples.english: Away from the noise of the city, this island is truly a world of its own.

examples.japanese: {同|おな}じ{会社|かいしゃ}でも、{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}は{雰囲気|ふんいき}がまったく{違|ちが}う{別天地|べってんち}らしい。
examples.english: Even within the same company, the research lab is apparently a world apart in atmosphere.

notes:
Formed from {別|べつ} (separate) + {天地|てんち} (heaven and earth, the world). Most often used with まるで or まさに to compare a real place to an ideal one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- まるで{別天地|べってんち}だ: it is just like another world
- {別天地|べってんち}のような{場所|ばしょ}: a place like a world apart
- ここは{別天地|べってんち}だ: this is a place apart

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {桃源郷|とうげんきょう}: Shangri-La — a legendary utopia, more literary and idealized
- {楽園|らくえん}: paradise — emphasizes pleasure and abundance rather than separation from the ordinary
- {別世界|べっせかい}: another world — near-synonym, but can also describe social worlds one does not belong to
